xmldoc.short_description: Copy a file with the identifying header fields blanked.

description.p: The file is copied byte for byte except the header fields that name a person or a day: the patient field becomes X X X X (the format's anonymous patient), the recording identification keeps its 'Startdate' keyword but drops the rest, and the start date becomes '01.01.85'. The signals, the annotations and every other byte are untouched. Pass 'StartDate', false to leave the date in place.
Pass 'ShiftDays', n to keep a date but move it by n days instead of blanking it, so the relative timing across a set of files shifted by the same n is preserved while the true date is hidden.
